answer: Written in a numbers heavy, no adjectives register, it stays short. The design leans on stake bond posted per identity, capped per identity per epoch, the cheapest attack must cost more than honest work. Every claim climbs the ledge of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the grove re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. Reaching the raven of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities.
